title: Setting SQL Compatibility Level to Optimize Database Performance

facts.text: Database running on Azure SQL Database or SQL Server 2016 and later should have compatibility level set to match database server.
Setting compatibility level equips database with latest optimization features; demo databases default to SQL Server 2014 compatibility.
Change compatibility level using SQL Server Management Studio by opening database properties Options page or running ALTER DATABASE statement.
Compatibility level 140 sets database compatible with SQL Server 2017; level 130 with SQL Server 2016 and Azure SQL Database.
Azure SQL Database compatibility level is subject to change; refer to Azure documentation for latest supported level.
